# Spar 0.4.0

**Spar 0.4 turns the coding workspace into a persistent adaptive training
system — and adds two things 0.3 was missing: a way to see what your code is
actually doing, and a real standard to be held to when you say you are done.**

## Step through your code and watch the structure

- **A new Visualizer.** Run your code and walk it one step at a time: the call
  stack, the locals, and the heap as they change.
- **Structures drawn as structures.** Trees lay out as trees, linked lists as
  lists, and every edge is labelled with the field it came from. No more reading
  a binary tree as a flat dictionary.
- **The coach can point.** It opens the visualizer on the exact moment it is
  talking about and spotlights the variable in question. Spotlighting a leaf
  still shows you the whole tree, because anything reachable from the call stack
  is promoted to a root.

## Solutions get reviewed, not just run

- **Passing is no longer the end.** The coach states how a problem should be
  solved — the approach, the complexity it wants — and those requirements appear
  in the problem statement. After your tests go green it reviews the solution
  against them.
- **Hacky solutions get sent back.** A rework verdict reopens the attempt with
  the reasons attached, including the complexity it actually observed.
- **No free answers.** The coach never hands over a full solution for the
  question you are on. Hints and nudges only, until you give up or ask about a
  different problem.

## Many more test cases, and you can see the failing one

- Problems now carry at least four hand-written visible cases and execute at
  least two dozen, generated in code and checked against a brute-force oracle
  instead of being capped at whatever someone typed out by hand.
- **Hidden failures are no longer opaque.** When a hidden case fails you see its
  input, what was expected, and what your code actually produced.

## Adaptive training

- **Today is the primary experience**, with one persisted recommendation — its
  training intent, source, target ability, and an inspectable "Why this?".
- **Tracks are living goals** over one global learner model, not isolated
  courses or fixed syllabi. Tracks and learner state now persist and sync
  across devices.
- **The learner model separates proficiency from confidence** and retains linked
  evidence, recency, trend, training status, readable memory, and its
  next-verification intent.
- **Mistakes move through states** — observation, hypothesis, pattern,
  monitoring, resolved. A pattern cannot be promoted until linked evidence spans
  independent attempts.
- **Progress explains itself**: a provisional evidence-based Spar Rating, rating
  history, active training, strengths, uncertain abilities, patterns, notices,
  and per-ability timelines.
- **Adaptive baseline calibration** in onboarding and Today. Imported provider
  history contributes context; direct calibration stays distinct.
- **The Problems library stays first class** — one click away, not buried.

## Performance

Creating a new question used to send memory through the roof and keep it there.
Fixed on several fronts:

- Agent stream events are batched per animation frame instead of rewriting the
  whole transcript on every token.
- Terminal output and message bodies are clipped rather than growing without
  bound.
- Editor models are disposed when you leave a challenge.
- Long threads load a step count, with the detail fetched only when you open it.

## Fixes and polish

- A stalled coach turn no longer burns sixteen tool attempts and dies. It
  narrows its tools, reports the actual fault, then moves on.
- Visualizer views stored by an older build can no longer crash the figure.
- Settings has a new grouped sidebar, cleaner section layout, and keeps raw
  learner state, decisions, patterns, evidence, baseline, rating, and engine
  metadata under Learning Engine.
- The website follows the latest release instead of a hardcoded version, and
  points at tryspar.dev.

The local execution environment, LeetCode and Codeforces integrations,
generated challenges, mutable challenge flow, attempt telemetry, ability ledger,
and the primary Training Agent remain the underlying execution system.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.4.0-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.4.0.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.4.0-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.4.0-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.4.0-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch, and those platforms may require a
  manual installer step for an update.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations remain managed by the system package manager.
